T: One day with Dad. One big feast.
D: Two elf brothers set out on a quest to bring back their late father for one day.
P: Serve the mains when the brothers pull up at the Manticore's tavern.
S: Crumbed mozzarella sticks fried until melting, with warm marinara for dunking. Cut 400g firm mozzarella into 16 sticks.
the fast food stop on the quest

Little beef sliders with cheese, pickles and sauce on soft mini buns. Shape 500g beef mince into 12 small patties, season and cook on a hot pan for 2 minutes a side, adding a slice of cheese at the end.

Puff pastry spread with tomato paste, ham and mozzarella, rolled into scrolls, baked golden and wrapped in paper for the road trip. Lay 2 sheets puff pastry on the bench. Spread each with 2 tbsp tomato paste mixed with half a teaspoon of dried oregano. Scatter with 150g chopped ham and 150g grated mozzarella, leaving a 2cm border on one edge. Roll up tightly towards the border, then cut each log into 8 scrolls. Lay cut side up on a lined tray and bake at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden. Cool 5 minutes before eating.
M: the brothers on the road together
Chicken drumsticks glazed with honey, garlic and thyme, roasted at 200C for 40 minutes, with roast potatoes and carrots.
New Mushroomton mushroom and leek pie

Mixed mushrooms and leek cooked down in butter with thyme and cream, spooned into a dish, topped with puff pastry and baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Melt 50g butter in a big pan and cook 750g mixed mushrooms, torn or sliced, over high heat until golden. Add 2 sliced leeks, 2 garlic cloves and a few thyme sprigs and cook 8 minutes until soft. Stir in 1 tbsp plain flour, then 150ml cream and 100ml vegetable stock and simmer until thick. Season well and spoon into a pie dish. Top with 1 sheet puff pastry, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
W: the one day the boys get with their dad
Vanilla ice cream in tall glasses with hot chocolate sauce of melted dark chocolate and cream, whipped cream and sprinkles.
K: the magic staff and the visitation spell
Apple juice and blackcurrant cordial topped with soda water over ice, purple like a potion.

s.how: Cut 400g firm mozzarella into 16 sticks. Roll in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs twice and freeze 30 minutes. Fry at 180C for 1 minute until golden and serve with 300g warm marinara.

s.note: the fast food stop on the quest
s.how: Shape 500g beef mince into 12 small patties, season and cook on a hot pan for 2 minutes a side, adding a slice of cheese at the end. Put in 12 slider buns with pickles and tomato sauce.

m.note: the brothers on the road together
m.how: Toss 8 chicken drumsticks with honey, crushed garlic, thyme and oil. Roast at 200C for 40 minutes alongside 1kg potato chunks and 4 sliced carrots, turning once. Serve on one big tray for two brothers on a quest.

w.note: the one day the boys get with their dad
w.how: Heat 150ml cream until steaming and pour over 150g chopped dark chocolate, stirring into hot fudge. Scoop vanilla ice cream into tall glasses, pour over the fudge and top with whipped cream and sprinkles. One more day well spent.

d.note: the magic staff and the visitation spell
d.how: Fill glasses with ice. Pour in apple juice to halfway, add a splash of blackcurrant cordial and top with soda water. Stir until it turns purple like a potion. Serve with a pinch of magic.
